name: io.github.kenb38291-tech/fastmcp-sqlite
title: FastMCP SQLite
description: Production-grade, token-optimized FastMCP SQLite Server with O(1) schema discovery, opcode execution watchdog, cell truncation, and fuzzy schema self-healing.

arguments.name: db_positional
arguments.description: Optional path to a SQLite database file (.db, .sqlite, .sqlite3) or directory.

arguments.name: --read-only
arguments.description: Enforce strict read-only execution across all database connections via PRAGMA query_only = ON.

arguments.name: --allowed-dir
arguments.description: Root directory boundary to restrict database and export operations (Zero-Trust sandbox).

arguments.name: --max-bytes
arguments.description: Strict UTF-8 byte payload ceiling per query (default: 24576 / 24KB).

arguments.name: --cell-max-chars
arguments.description: Maximum characters per cell before truncation (default: 200).

arguments.name: --opcode-limit
arguments.description: Opcode instruction watchdog limit for runaway query abort (default: 1000000).
